segmento.amor:
Venus is affection, taste, and beauty: what you attract without having to push for it. Its lines on the map point to the places where that switches on for you — where connection comes more easily, where the way you deal with people opens doors, and where what you do lands well with others.

The four lines don't say the same thing. On the line where you get recognized, Venus turns into trade and reputation: art, aesthetics, design, public relations, success through popularity. On the one you live behind closed doors, it becomes home and family, and love can reach you through family. Where people notice you, Venus gets into your body and your personality: you come across as brighter, more harmonious, more alluring. And where it comes through others, it shows up through people — your partner, your business partners, your alliances.

When Venus crosses Jupiter, what you find also grows: there you don't just find advantages, you find abundance, with recognition and prosperity in the mix.

What to watch closely: Venus doesn't push. It hands you easy ground, and easy ground also invites you to stay put, to please, to skip the fight you sometimes have to pick. If the problem in your life isn't a shortage of affection but a surplus of comfort, these zones will underline it.
segmento.vocacion:
Jupiter enlarges whatever it touches. Where its lines run, things grow: your career, your trade, your knowledge, your house, your circle of people. It's the planet of opportunity, and opportunity on the map isn't some abstract stroke of luck — it means that in that place things flow easily.

On the line where you get recognized, what grows is success: achievements, wins, recognition, and an interest that wakes up in you for philosophy and for the administration of justice. On the one you live behind closed doors, the house grows — a big house, a large family, prosperity that comes in through your roots. Where people notice you, what grows is you: you're seen more, you can become an authority on something and earn respect. And where it comes through others, your contacts, your allies, and your social standing grow; there you're even, in a way, protected from the enemies you know about.

The crossings fine-tune it. With the Sun you shine for what you know and for your judgment. With Venus, the expansion arrives through affection and harmony, and it can bring you a partner or very good associates.

What to watch closely: Jupiter doesn't know how to say enough. It expands the good, and it also expands your spending, the promise of more, and your pride. And it's literal about the body and health: you have to be careful with excess.
segmento.familia:
The Moon is what you feel before you think it: home, family, memory, habit, the need to belong. Its lines point to the places where that wakes up in you, for better and for worse, because the Moon doesn't tell the difference between feeling at home and feeling adrift.

Where you live it behind closed doors is where it shows up most clearly: there you can put down roots, start a family, build the home, and the place feels like your shelter. Where you get recognized, the emotional and the professional mix — your work can have to do with real estate, with food, or with family business, and there's a sense of familiarity with the place. Where people notice you, your emotions run high and your maternal or paternal side wakes up, the one that protects and feeds. And where it comes through others, what you feel goes into serving other people: you protect in order to feel protected.

With Jupiter, family and emotions get bigger — a big house, a roomy home, a place that can nourish you a great deal. With Venus, home and roots become a source of peace, and your social life is lived as though it were family.

What to watch closely: the Moon rises and falls. In these zones you can feel at home one month and adrift the next, and relationships can turn unstable. What holds you steady is the same thing that moves you.
segmento.imaginacion:
Neptune dissolves edges. Where its lines run, in comes everything that can't be reasoned out — inspiration, compassion, the mystical, art — and at the same time it gets harder to see clearly. The two are the same thing: for something new to come in, the outline of the old has to soften.

Where you get recognized, you can feel deeply inspired to serve other people, but you can also fail to get the attention you expected, and the idea of success you arrived with can dissolve on you. Where you live it behind closed doors, confusion and dependency come in through family, and the feeling of having to sacrifice yourself for them can show up. Where people notice you is the mirror zone: if you look at yourself, what do you see? Useful for looking inward, not for trying to see outward. And where it comes through others, the need to serve pours onto your partner and your associates, and there you have to know how to tell love apart from dependency.

With the Moon, idealism gets into your emotional life and you can lose your sense of direction; it's good ground for mysticism if you manage to keep your feet on the earth. With Pluto, passion and spirituality switch on at once, and what was hidden comes to light.

What to watch closely: playing the victim, and escapism. Neptune puts the most comfortable exit door there is right in front of you, and it isn't always wise to walk through it.
segmento.emocion:
Uranus breaks things. Where its lines run, things don't go on the way they were: they change all at once, and often without your having asked. This is the segment of places that don't leave you the way they found you, and that's why it has the most crossings — Uranus meddles with everything else.

Where you get recognized, what gets shaken is your career: it's good ground for changing something or breaking free of it, and that something can be your own idea of success. Where you live it behind closed doors, family and house stop being the conventional kind, and it's very good ground for letting go of burdens you've been dragging down from your family line. Where people notice you, you show up different, with a very large need for freedom and a wish to resemble nobody. And where it comes through others, relationships turn unconventional and change arrives hard.

The six crossings give it its color. With Mars, boldness and explosiveness. With Mercury, a chaotic mind that's full of ideas. With Saturn, the battle between what you should do and what you'd rather. With the Sun, shining in an unusual way. With Pluto, transformation and release. With the Moon, family life lived like a hurricane.

What to watch closely: being uprooted. Uranus frees, but it also cuts, and it doesn't always cut what was expendable. Before you move to one of these zones it's worth knowing what you want to be free of — because if you don't know, it picks for you.
segmento.educacion:
Mercury is the word, the mind, learning, and ideas. Where its lines run, your head switches on: ideas come more easily, contacts turn up, and anything done by talking or writing finds ground.

Where you get recognized, communications, business, networking, marketing, and sales all benefit, and it's good ground for pitching a project. Where you live it behind closed doors, home fills up with movement and with duality, but your own company and your personal brand get plenty of ideas. Where people notice you, creativity, resourcefulness, and your ability to adapt all switch on, and so does the duality: one day you feel happy and the next you don't. And where it comes through others, exchange is what rules — sharing ideas, making use of the ones that arrive, serving as a bridge.

With Jupiter, the mind thinks big and the zone works as well for learning as for teaching. With Saturn, the mind turns logical and contacts become serious and lasting. With Pluto, your word gains power and ideas turn transformative — and there it pays to read the fine print.

What to watch closely: scattering, and lies. Mercury moves many things at once and not all of them make it to port, and in these zones it pays to know what you're looking for before you go out looking for it.
segmento.enfoque:
Saturn collects and pays. Where its lines run, nothing comes free, but what you get, you keep. It's the planet of time, of effort, and of the limit, and on the map it points to the places where you're going to have to work — and where that work builds something that lasts.

Where you get recognized, toughness and perseverance switch on in you, and a very severe judge can come out from inside you. It's good ground for reaching goals through effort and structure, and also for asking yourself what you consider success to be. Where you live it behind closed doors, the difficulties show up in family life, home can feel cold, and this is the zone for recognizing what you carry as dead weight through your family line. Where people notice you, you can come across as more mature than you are, and other people can see you as cold or distant. And where it comes through others, relationships weigh on you like a responsibility — but they're the ones that get built solid and lasting.

With the Sun, the shine comes slowly but well supported. With the Moon, emotions get structured and family and home take material form. With Mercury, concentration and caution.

What to watch closely: joy, which Saturn leaves out: what you get here is raw reality, with no anesthesia. And it's worth saying plainly: if you want to work hard and work long, these are your zones. If you don't want that, they aren't.
segmento.retos:
Mars, Saturn, Pluto · crossings among them

The two malefics of the tradition — Mars and Saturn — plus Pluto, which modern astrology added to them. Three planets, not one, and that's why this segment covers more of the world than the others.

These aren't forbidden zones. They're zones with a price. Every planet has two possible ways out, and here the distance between the one and the other is wider than in any other segment: Mars is initiative and also the fight, Saturn is duty and also the wall, Pluto is transformation and also death — and not only the physical kind: endings too. What decides which of the two you get isn't the place alone: it's you, and whatever you're carrying when you arrive, plus the energy of the place.

Mars ignites: where its lines run, the warrior, leadership, boldness, and anxiety all switch on in you, and home can turn into a battlefield. Saturn audits, structures, and collects: hard work, the limit, the inner judge, the relationships that weigh on you but that last. Pluto stirs up what was buried: power, crisis, magnetism, what comes down hidden in the family line.

Where they cross one another is where you have to look hardest. Mars with Saturn switches on the possibility of accidents or falls, and conflicts with authority figures. Mars with Pluto is a combination to handle with care: it draws dangerous situations, and it isn't wise to take unnecessary risks. Pluto with Saturn is dying and being born again — leaving one self behind and building a new one, with everything that costs.

What to watch closely: these zones aren't to be avoided — they're to be prepared for in advance. If you arrive knowing what you're there for, the place works in your favor. If you arrive not knowing, it works on its own. Caution, always.
linea.venus.mc: Benefits switch on for you in romantic matters: you can meet someone you'd have a love relationship with. You also attract benefits professionally, and you receive recognition. Matters tied to art, beauty, aesthetics, design, social contacts, and public relations, and significant achievements that bring peace and well-being. Success through popularity, lucrative projects. Personal charm.
linea.venus.ic: Benefits switch on for you in family matters and in the home. If you set up your home or your family here, it will mean well-being, happiness, and harmony. You can also find love through family matters. It's good for strengthening your personal brand and for finding people who help you gain advantages in your own company and in yourself as a brand.
linea.venus.asc: Benefits switch on for you in personal relationships. You come across as someone with great charisma, you're seen much more, and seen as brighter, more harmonious, more alluring. This place can make you feel more comfortable, maybe even more stagnant, with inner peace and calm. You can develop or switch on artistic abilities, or abilities tied to the world of design, fashion, music, and beauty.
linea.venus.desc: Benefits switch on for you in marriage, in living together, in alliances, and in partnerships: this is a zone for tightening bonds or for meeting someone special. You or the people around you come across as more affectionate and more cooperative. Relationships with other people come more easily; in marriage it would mean harmony between the two of you. Kindness in relationships. Artistic talent that other people value.
linea.jupiter.mc: Large benefits switch on for you professionally, in recognition, and in success. Everything connected to your career or your trade expands and grows. This is a zone for building up significant achievements and wins. The wisdom and the knowledge you acquire here are very good for growing professionally. An interest in philosophical subjects or in subjects tied to the administration of justice.
linea.jupiter.ic: Large benefits switch on for you in matters of home and family, along with prosperity. It also helps a great deal in expanding your personal brand or your own company. In the home it can mean a big house or a large family. You learn and gain wisdom through family matters or through your roots. And you may well have to move or travel more often for family reasons. Longevity.
linea.jupiter.asc: Large benefits switch on for you tied to your personality and to being seen much more. This is a zone where you attract good luck and good fortune easily. You can become an authority on something and earn respect. You have to be careful with excess: it can make you gain weight easily, for example. It's very useful for showing other people the knowledge or the wisdom you have, for putting yourself out there. Careful with pride.
linea.jupiter.desc: Large benefits switch on for you in everything tied to contacts, allies, relationships, and partners, and in marriage or living together. Social standing. You can learn a great deal through other people, and socially it's easy to receive recognition. Careful with excess and with grandiosity. You can share your wisdom with others. And here you're protected, in a way, from the enemies you know about.
linea.luna.mc: Matters of public image and popularity switch on for you. The professional and the family sides connect or combine: your profession or your trade can have to do with real estate, with food, or with family business. Good zone for showing yourself, for presenting or pitching projects. And there's a sense of familiarity with the place. The emotional and the professional can also go through ups and downs and changes of direction.
linea.luna.ic: The feeling of being at home switches on for you. Here you can put down roots, start a family, build the home, and your home and your family may well feel like your shelter. Introversion. A sense of shelter, or a need for it. There's no rush and no hunt for the spotlight. Changes of house, or changes in the house, can also happen. Your own company, tied to real estate or to food.
linea.luna.asc: Your emotions run high and you're more sensitive, and for that same reason you have to channel that emotionality better. Your maternal or paternal side wakes up, the need to protect and to nourish other people. Fertility also switches on, in every sense. And if you're protective, you also need to feel protected. People can recognize you as loving and as a caretaker of others. And they can see you as a very changeable personality.
linea.luna.desc: Your emotions, your feelings, and your intuition go into the service of other people. It can happen that you put others first, ahead of yourself. In your personal relationships you also protect in order to feel protected: if I take care of you, you take care of me. You have to be careful with emotional excess and with how you relate to other people. Relationships can turn a little unstable. Social popularity.
linea.neptuno.mc: You can feel deeply inspired to serve other people; mysticism. It can also happen that you don't feel you're getting the attention or the recognition you expected. Professional matters, or whatever idea of success you hold, can dissolve, and you may well feel confused about your career in particular. If you want to devote yourself to service, or to make sacrifice for others your trade, this is a good zone for pulling it off. Careful with escapism and with playing the victim. High ideals.
linea.neptuno.ic: In family matters, in the home you were born into or the one you build, you can feel confusion or a great deal of dependency. You perceive things you believe to be reality, and they may not be. With family, the feeling of having to serve them or sacrifice yourself for them can arise. You have to be cautious about disconnecting from reality or living on illusions. Home and spirituality are connected here, but there you have to know how to use discernment.
linea.neptuno.asc: Intuition switches on for you and, at times, a feeling of confusion about yourself: if you look in the mirror, what do you see? You may perceive something different from reality. This is a good zone for looking inward and getting to know yourself, and not for trying to see so much outward. At times you can feel you go unnoticed. Your spiritual side benefits here. It's a zone where inspiration and idealism switch on and grow large. Careful with playing the victim.
linea.neptuno.desc: Here it's worth asking yourself: how do other people see you? You may feel a great need to serve your partner, your associates, or your allies. You have to be cautious about the kind of relationships you enter into: if they're toxic relationships, you have to identify them, and the same goes if relationships of dependency form. Spirituality and working with other people toward self-knowledge, without losing the ground under you or losing hold of reality. Do my relationships with other people lead me into sacrifices? Do I put other people first, ahead of myself? Do I idealize my partner or my relationships?
linea.urano.mc: Very significant changes happen in your professional life and in your career. This is a good zone for freeing yourself from something, and that something can be whatever idea of success you hold. It's also very positive to move into innovation and technology: anything disruptive in fame, reputation, and success can switch on. It's very useful for seeing your whole professional life from another angle. You have to be careful with the chaos, which can affect family matters.
linea.urano.ic: Family and home matters aren't the conventional kind: the house you live in or the family you build can go through constant or unexpected changes. This is a very good zone for freeing yourself from subconscious matters, or from burdens you've been dragging along in your family line. It can be very good to innovate, change, or refresh your personal brand or your own company, or to tie them to technology. Some chaos gets generated on the domestic side.
linea.urano.asc: In how you project yourself you can come across as a very different person, or a disruptive one. Originality. There's a very large need for freedom, for making changes in your own image, for not resembling anyone else. You have to be careful about turning into a rebel without a cause. And it can be very useful for freeing yourself from personality traits that you feel have become a burden or no longer give you anything. An interest in the technological, the revolutionary, the advanced, and the visionary.
linea.urano.desc: Relationships with other people can be unconventional: in marriage, in partnerships, and with allies, radical or unexpected changes show up. This is a zone for innovating, refreshing, or freeing yourself from relationships. Good for changing the way you relate and for seeing yourself through the relationships you create. Many of the changes arrive hard. Matters of relationship and of community are very important.
linea.mercurio.mc: Everything connected to communications, business, networking, public relations, marketing, and sales benefits here. You can cultivate contacts that bring you advantages professionally. But careful with lies and deception. Good zone for pitching a project, for communicating, and for having very productive ideas. Constant movement on the professional side.
linea.mercurio.ic: Everything connected to home and family can go through some duality, some instability, or constant movement. In your own company and in your personal brand, plenty of ideas and possibilities switch on for you. A great capacity to adapt, but with that feeling of looking for something you sometimes can't manage to find. You have to become aware of your own thinking: does it serve you or doesn't it?
linea.mercurio.asc: Everything connected to your ability to communicate switches on for you: ideas, creativity, resourcefulness, and the capacity to adapt. But the duality switches on too: one day you can feel happy and the next you don't. Here you have to learn to recognize and to reconcile those two selves. Commerce, marketing, and business benefit. You can serve as a bridge between other people, ideas, or businesses.
linea.mercurio.desc: Everything connected to communication and to personal relationships switches on for you. Sometimes it happens that you build relationships as though they were business deals. This is a very good location for sharing ideas with other people, or for making use of the ones that come to you from them, and it's very positive for exchanges of every kind. In marriage, some instability or some doubt can arise. It's worth asking yourself what you're looking for through other people: that's what you have to learn to find in yourself first.
linea.saturno.mc: Toughness switches on for you at times, and so does perseverance. A very severe judge can come out from inside you. This is a good zone for working hard, with effort and with structure, and in that way reaching whatever goals you set. Here you have to define what you consider success to be, and what fears switch on in you around the feeling of failure. It can give you some pessimism, or the need to have a great many variables accounted for in advance. People can recognize you as methodical and rigid, or consider you emotionally cold. You can also come to be an authority on some subject. If you want to work hard and work long, this is the zone. If you don't want that, this isn't the zone.
linea.saturno.ic: The difficulties show up for you in matters of family and home. This can be very useful for recognizing what you carry as dead weight or as karma through your family line. Home, family, or your house can feel cold, as though more love or more joy were missing. You can feel that you frequently have obstacles to face, or that life is “hard,” or that life is “effort.” But it's a very good zone for identifying what serves and what doesn't among the things you carry in your subconscious. Good for structuring your base and your foundations better, if you're willing to work at it.
linea.saturno.asc: A very judgmental personality can emerge in you, judgmental of yourself and of other people. You can seem or present as more mature than you really are, and other people can see you as a cold, reserved, or distant person. Good abilities for making things material, for making them concrete, and for directing. But you can fall into dogmatism or into rigidity.
linea.saturno.desc: You can feel, or decide, that you build relationships that are a burden and a responsibility: it's like carrying other people's crosses. Your partner or your associates can be serious, cold, distant, or judges of you. But you can also build very solid and lasting relationships. The challenge is not to lose your joy, to get out of the rigidity, and not to become unsociable or isolate yourself even while you're in a relationship, a marriage, or a partnership.
linea.marte.mc: You can stand out for a great capacity for leadership and for boldness. You reap what you sow, and if you sow conflict, conflict is what you'll reap across your whole professional life. Here you have good skills for taking on more risk and more challenge. Are they going to recognize you as a good leader, or as someone who picks fights? You can be a pioneer in something, you can start projects, but staying the course can cost you effort. How much anxiety does work produce in you, or success?
linea.marte.ic: Home and family can feel like, or turn into, a battlefield. Could it be that the conflict comes from inside you? At times you're predisposed, as a protective mechanism, to feel attacked. This can be a very good zone for starting your own business, and for working on your psychological base and on how that base shows up in your personal brand. If you find the right way to channel and focus your energy, and the energy that gets produced in the home, it can be very positive.
linea.marte.asc: The warrior you carry inside switches on. You can seem very combative or conflict-prone; you have the need to direct, to lead, to feel constant competition, and you like to compete and win. You can have a lot of energy available, but you have to channel it well or the anxiety switches on to excess. You can become very controlling, or go around telling other people what they ought to be doing.
linea.marte.desc: You can build tense and conflict-ridden relationships: marriage, living together, or partnerships can be grounds for dispute and for tension, and can put you up against several kinds of struggle. You can feel or live with an authoritarian partner. If relationships get built with shared objectives and precise goals, it can be very positive for focusing the energy on achieving whatever you set out to do as a team. You also have to identify the anxiety that relationships generate in you, and take care not to turn them into a constant battle. If you find the right associates you can lead large projects, knowing how to work as a team and not competing with your partners, your allies, or your spouse.
linea.pluton.mc: Your professional affairs end up tied to power and to investigation. It can also turn out to be hard for you to choose your trade or your profession: here the ideal thing would be to dig into yourself for whatever it is you're passionate about. You have to take care not to let yourself get caught by power, or not to handle it properly once you have it. It may be that hidden subjects attract you, or that the abilities of a good psychologist switch on in you without your having studied for it. You can serve as an agent of transformation for other people. The words crisis and transformation get lived out in everything connected to your trade or your profession.
linea.pluton.ic: Domestic and family affairs get lived with passion and intensity, and if you don't channel those energies well they can turn into catalysts for crisis. The house you live in can need transformations or changes frequently. It's a very interesting zone for traveling into your own subconscious and your psychological base, and for digging as well into those matters that have been hidden in the family line. And for asking yourself how power and passion have been handled by your ancestors.
linea.pluton.asc: A great personal power switches on for you, a very strong magnetism, which makes you attract the good and the bad. It's important that you learn to identify which energy you're feeding on. Here the “shaman” you carry inside switches on, and that's why you have several internal battles to fight, ones you'll often see as though other people were causing them. Power struggles switch on easily. But it's a good zone for developing a great capacity to help yourself, and to help other people, transform. Here you're very passionate. The self and power. A large personality.
linea.pluton.desc: Stormy relationships, the product of power struggles or of permanent crisis, switch on easily for you. But it can be very useful to you to build relationships that are grounds for transformation: seeing as a team whatever it is the two of you are passionate about and focusing the energy toward a shared objective. You shouldn't look at the other person with suspicion or with disbelief: that would be fatal for the relationship.
cruce.jupiter.venus: Excellent for reaching whatever objectives you set and for growing enormously in wins, in recognition, in harmony, in peace, and in abundance. Also for learning from the culture and the philosophies of the place. Social, professional, and business contacts can switch success on for you. And you can find a partner, or very good associates and allies.
cruce.jupiter.sol: Very good for shining and receiving recognition: it's easy for you to stand out in something. You shine for what you know and for your wisdom, and also for your capacity to administer justice. Achieving great successes, coming into the light, showing yourself and being seen.
cruce.jupiter.luna: Great personal projection. The possibility of receiving recognition and awards. The family can get bigger, and so can the emotions: life is lived with great emotional intensity. It can mean a big house, or a large home and a large family. You can feel very comfortable and happy, as though that zone were your home, a place that can nourish you a great deal. It's worth studying its culture.
cruce.luna.venus: Home, family, and roots feel like sources of peace, of harmony, of well-being, and of calm. In romantic matters there's great sensitivity and intuition. This zone can also feel like your home, like a place that brings you peace and calm. Your social life is lived as though it were family.
cruce.luna.neptuno: Emotions and idealism: here you have to manage to keep your feet on the ground, because you can lose some of your sense of direction and get lost in yourself and in your emotions. In family life and in emotional life you have to take care not to idealize so much, because that can end up depressing you. It can be a very good zone for mysticism and for a deep spiritual connection.
cruce.neptuno.pluton: Passion and spirituality switch on for you here. What is hidden and hard for you to see; anxieties or fears that can switch on. Relationships that can be difficult, toxic, or based on power. Good zone if your purpose is to achieve a deep transformation, but you have to take care not to “lose” yourself. Growth in your level of consciousness is positive here, but only well directed.
cruce.luna.urano: Emotions a little chaotic, or family matters lived and felt like genuine hurricanes. Good zone if you want to free yourself from family issues. Home and family cost you some effort, precisely because of some kind of family instability, but you can connect with a freer and more disruptive emotional dimension, one in which you have to keep innovating. You look for stability but you want freedom.
cruce.marte.urano: Great boldness and leadership in out-of-the-ordinary matters. For developing an innovative energy. Here you have to recognize which battles are worth it, because you can be explosive or conflict-prone from the rebelliousness that switches on in you. Technology and the companies leading in innovation attract you out of a sense of competition, of being more visionary. Here you're ingenious, but at times unstable.
cruce.mercurio.urano: A mind a little chaotic, but with an enormous capacity to generate disruptive ideas. Social or business contacts out of the ordinary. You have to work hard at channeling and identifying your own thinking. In business and in networking, unexpected things are going to happen. The duality can switch on in you a great deal. But you can have very creative ideas, ones that serve society or the community.
cruce.pluton.urano: A search for independence. Opportunities for transformation and for release can come up for you. If you connect what you're passionate about with ingenuity and creativity, great projects and revolutionary ideas can emerge. Investigating technology and very novel projects. Take care that the chaos doesn't turn into your passion.
cruce.saturno.urano: Here a battle gets produced between what you should be or do and what you'd like to be or do: freedom against responsibility. It's a good zone for making transformative ideas or projects concrete and material. You can develop precision skills in technological subjects. It can also be ideal for freeing yourself from the feeling of restriction. Here the ideal is to work freedom with structure.
cruce.sol.urano: A love of freedom and an independent spirit; very revolutionary ideas. You can shine for your capacity to see things from other angles and for having very creative ideas, which can carry you to recognition. Science and technology switch on for you here. And you can shine in an unusual way.
cruce.jupiter.mercurio: The mind and your thinking on a large scale. The benefits of this zone show up for you in commerce and in communications. Very good for learning and also for teaching. Great projection through contacts and through large projects. Ideal for connecting with the knowledge and the culture of the place and making the most of them.
cruce.mercurio.pluton: The mind and transformation: going into your own depths to see yourself. Transformative ideas, and contacts that carry you to points of radical transformation. New ideas and new contacts can become a passion for you. The power of the word and of communication in every sense. Be careful with the business dealings and the relationships that get generated here: read the fine print to avoid deception or hidden matters.
cruce.mercurio.saturno: The logical, rational mind. This zone is very positive for making concrete ideas material, for establishing serious and lasting contacts in business and in the goals you want to reach, and for structuring those purposes. A great capacity for concentration, for prudence, and for weighing things carefully. It could also help you to know the history of this zone, of this place. Knowledge and foundations, structure.
cruce.luna.saturno: Emotions structured, or under constant evaluation. This zone helps you become aware of what moves you. Family and home matters can turn very serious or cold. You can also feel the need to take cover, to isolate yourself, or to protect yourself. You can make well-structured real estate deals material, deals that sometimes feel as though they aren't flowing at the speed you want, but that time turns stable.
cruce.saturno.sol: The shine and the essence, with structure and seriousness. Your essence on good foundations. You may feel things are a little slow, but once you reach it, that shine is going to be very well supported. It induces seriousness and maturity; it brings depth, judgment, and a great sense of duty. For developing long-term projects, the kind that require effort and persistence, and through which important things can be achieved.
cruce.marte.pluton: This combination is one to handle with care. It's easy for you to attract risky situations or experiences. It isn't in your interest to take unnecessary risks, or to get into conflicts that could carry you into dangerous situations. Matters that may be simple switch on great tension or conflict in you. Passion and adrenaline have to be measured out carefully. This zone brings you an intense energy that you have to know how to channel. This is the inner warrior empowered.
cruce.marte.saturno: You can go through conflicts with authority figures. Here too the ideal is not to take unnecessary risks: it can be a zone that switches on the possibility of accidents or falls. But it can be very useful to you for being assertive about whatever you want to achieve or make material, if you focus the energy well. You can be very domineering. A great will for fighting battles, but you have to know how to choose which ones are worth it and which ones aren't.
cruce.pluton.saturno: What you're passionate about, you can make material. Here you feel or live through forceful moments of transformation: it's like dying and being born again. It can be a good zone for leaving one self behind and building a new one. Great challenges or difficulties can switch on for you. You have to be aware of how you exercise power and of how other people exercise it over you. Passion with structure, which can bring you difficulties in love or in sexuality.
nota.estado.titulo: What's Left to Read and Interpret
nota.estado:
Up to here you've read where each planet sits in the world. The other half is missing: the condition each planet is in inside your own chart.

A planet doesn't arrive the same way everywhere. Venus in its own domicile is nothing like Venus in detriment or in fall. Mars in exaltation doesn't do what a peregrine Mars does — no dignity, no debility, just passing through. And the house it lands in rules too: there are houses where a planet sits in its joy, and houses where it sits in its sorrow.

That is the cosmic state of a planet, and the reading of the lines you have just received is completed by that state. The Jupiter line of someone with a strong Jupiter promises one thing; that same line, in a chart where Jupiter is badly placed, promises something quite different. The place is the same; what arrives there is not.

And this added layer matters even more if you choose any of these zones as your new place of residence. At that point you and I should look at a chart called a Relocation Chart.

There's something else. The lines you're seeing are also energies you can draw on, no matter where you live. It can be very good to get to know people from the zones your Jupiter and Venus lines run through, or to have contact with those countries and those cultures.

This report can't make that reading. It doesn't depend on the map but on your chart as a whole, and these are nuances you look at one by one. That is exactly what gets worked through in a consultation with me: your chart, your lines, and how well placed each planet is to deliver what its line promises.
